notes: Independence: read only the assigned brief, packet, preamble, notation snapshot, this page’s whole image/halves and local crops. The whole was opened once for layout, then half a once and half b once. All 13 crops were made in one batch and viewed once each; no recrop, OCR, external research, other page, other reader or root decision was used.

Actual order: UTC start recorded before packet reading. Both witness texts and all packet tables/notes were read before images. Image dimensions are whole 1678 by 1206 and halves 899 by 1206. Half a begins at full x=0; half b corresponds to full x=779, with a 120-pixel overlap. Report bounds are full-scan coordinates.

Content: handwritten mathematical displays involving P, Hom, products and inclusions; a small disk/petal drawing; a right-hand arrow diagram; three larger drawings at the foot. There is no prose title or date. The sole numbering is pale archive 10 at lower left, retained only in a comment.
Author uncertainty: the exact written sign ? stands above the top relation. No prose claim of verification is present.

C uncertainty-table mapping: there are exactly 15 source rows. CD01 edge; CD02 first P; CD03a--d map the separated top/middle Z places (the first marker carries the recurring unresolved rounded form); CD04 predecessor; CD05 final E; CD06 cancelled Hom; CD07a--b operator and little first argument; CD08 oval; CD09 lower predecessor; CD10a--b raised H and arch; CD11a--b underlying leading letter and e; CD12 arrow-side letter; CD13 both overlaid right object forms; CD14a--b subscript and lower letter; CD15a--c three raised forms. Source rows are counted once, while local decisions are explicit.

Notation-table entries, the retained-slips table and the Hom abbreviation row are apparatus categories. They were inspected and do not create additional C doubt rows. The two missing outer closures are retained. The three lower plain-P readings and the three actually underlined Hom spans were read independently.

H editorial note and drawing descriptions are apparatus; their French explanatory wording is not transcribed as manuscript text or counted as invented manuscript prose. Specific candidate letters, cancellation states, punctuation and the finer drawing paths remain subject to collation. H page 10 is the supplied scan-minus-one convention, not an authorial mspage.

The upper-right live inner Hom arguments are kept in the observed order E,Z. No formula was repaired to an expected form. No proof, algebraic correspondence or numerical check was performed; check_events is empty.

The raised M/H/R shapes are retained with C’s deletion annotation, and all long visible crossing paths are drawn. Their crossings supply no writing chronology. Local faint detached shapes retain shape/role uncertainty; they have no supplied mathematical relationship.

Upper drawing path audit: retained all C main paths after checking shaft, disk, central fill, radii, petal arcs and descending outer path. Added internal hook, small shallow dash, curl beside shaft, outer upper hook, lower-right hooked ray return, second lower-left rim arc and small lower shaft branch. The enlarged detail crop begins at x=306; the already-read leftmost ray endpoint at about x=256 is supplied by half a and retained in the C path. No enlargement was repeated.

Bottom drawing audit: the left polygon, middle angled paths and right oval were individually matched to the visible halves, including thick versus thin segments and the two little internal zigzag groups. Their C TikZ paths are retained. The archive numeral now has its own inventory item.

Validation is structural only: braces, environment nesting, macro vocabulary, required report keys, exact permitted difference/inventory kinds, crop references and reading/report consistency. No TeX compiler, format builder, package installation, PDF or render validation was invoked.

The detached dot-shaped trace above-left of the tall diagram upright is preserved as N06. Its compact visible shape is separate from the formula and upright; hand, surface origin and role remain open. This was read in the existing crop 13, without a further crop.

Crop 06 ends through the drawing/curved continuation at the expression’s right edge. The O and double-stem P targets are complete; the full continuation was read on half a and is contained in existing crop 07. No character is inferred from that clipped edge, and no repeat enlargement was made.
